title: Final Inspection Checklist
name: Final Inspection Checklist
description: Final completion and handover inspection record for documenting readiness, outstanding items, commissioning records and acceptance status. It is an inspection record rather than a permit to work.

sections.title: COMPLETION VERIFICATION
items: The agreed scope of works is complete for the area being inspected
Outstanding defects and snagging items have been reviewed
Required testing and commissioning records are available
Life-safety and protective systems relevant to the area are operational or formally handed over
Temporary works, temporary services and protection have been removed or formally retained
The area is safe, clean and suitable for the intended handover stage

sections.title: DOCUMENTATION AND HANDOVER
items: Required as-built information has been provided or its outstanding status recorded
O&M / maintenance information relevant to the handover has been provided or tracked
Required certificates, test results and commissioning records have been handed over or tracked
Keys, access controls, isolations and operational restrictions have been communicated
Outstanding actions have an owner and target date

sections.title: FINAL ACCEPTANCE
items: The final inspection outcome has been communicated to the responsible team
Any item preventing handover is clearly identified
Any conditional acceptance is documented with its conditions
A re-inspection date is identified where the area is not fully accepted
The final inspection record will be retained with project handover records
